Bei HelloFresh ist unsere Mission einfach: To change the way people, eat forever. Als globales, digital-natives FMCG-Unternehmen und weltweit führender Anbieter von Kochboxen gestalten wir die traditionelle Lebensmittel-Lieferkette neu - mit einem datengetriebenen On-Demand-Modell, das skalierbares Wachstum ermöglicht und Lebensmittel nachhaltiger liefert. Zur HelloFresh Group gehören acht Marken, darunter HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate und Chef Plate sowie Ready-to-eat Angebote von Factor und YouFoodz, Fleisch- und Meeeresfrüchte Abonnements von Good Chop und Tiernahrung von The Pets Table. Durch Technologie, Daten und kulinarische Innovation schaffen wir personalisierte Food-Erlebnisse für Millionen von Haushalten weltweit.The role:What's in the BoxAs a Strategic Demand Capacity Planner, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the long-term alignment between European market demand and our global supplier, production, and logistics networks. Sitting within the Central Planning team and nested in the International Operations department, you will report directly to the Associate Director of Strategic Planning.Your mission is to bridge the gap between commercial ambition and operational reality. By working closely with Product, Marketing, and Forecasting teams, you will translate long-range demand signals into actionable capacity strategies, ensuring our network is prepared for future growth and evolving market shifts.Please note that this position is a 24-month fixed-term contract (with the aim of converting it to a permanent position afterwards).What you’ll do: The Recipe- Support the Forecasting team in developing a long-term forecast for strategic decision-making.- Conduct industry research on supplier and logistics network trends, as well as developments in digital technology for planning tools.- Analyze and monitor capacity utilization in our operational country clusters (suppliers, production, logistics network), enabling proactive risk management of our supply chain rather than reactive, wasteful incident handling.- Assist in scenario planning and ad-hoc simulations on our supplier and fulfillment network for demand alteration activities affecting our end-to-end capacities- Translate forecasted demand into actionable procurement and production plans, making tactical decisions to prevent financial waste- Promote the development and implementation of the HelloFresh Planning Target Operating Model including the deployment of an Advanced Planning ToolWhat you’ll bring: The Ingredients- 4+ years of professional experience in a similar role.- A university degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Economics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.- Initial experience in strategic roles at the intersection of demand and supply, or a background in consulting, is considered an advantage.- Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage data to inform decision-making.- Interest in senior stakeholder management and a desire to drive value by orchestrating cross-functional problem-solving initiatives across operational functions.- Effective communication skills in English; German language skills are a plus. Ability to collaborate across international and cross-functional teams.- A business-oriented mindset combined with a data- and process-driven approach to work.What we offer: The ToppingsElevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.- Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.- Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.- Exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.- Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.- Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!Are you the missing ingredient?If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Supply-Chain-Management

jobs.description: Job available in 2 locations: Karlsruhe, MunichWork ScheduleStandard (Mon-Fri)Environmental ConditionsOfficeJob DescriptionAre you a last year university student or recent graduate who would like to take his\her first steps within a dynamic clinical research organization? Are you interested in learning fundamental skills to start effectively your career?At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.How will you make an impact?The 6 month internship in Clinical Operations is designed to offer you the opportunity to develop insight into clinical research, master your skills while conducting meaningful work within the team. The programme framework is crafted to allow you to grow professionally, learning invaluable skills to help you kick start your career!What you will do?As part of the Clinical Operations, you will work closely as a team, providing support and ideas for day to day activities. Your engagement and level of dedication will ensure that our project teams would receive the administrative and technical support they needs. You will have a mentor who will help you navigate through our organization and processes and receive the best support, which will ensure you are on your way to reaching your goals.You will need to be in the office three days each week, with flexibility to work from home on the other days.Being part of the Clinical Operations team, you will be introduced to many diverse parts of the company and to other interns across Europe. You will have a wide portfolio of exciting tasks to complete. Plus test your natural curiosity in providing administrative and technical support to the team proactively, educating yourself about the clinical research industry and master your skills to measure your business progress.How will you get here?- You are last year university student looking for an entry level position- Successfully completed 2nd state examination as part of the pharmacy degree (according to §1 AAppO)- You have the ability to handle numerous tasks simultaneously- You enjoy working in a team- You also have excellent administration and organization skills and the ability to prioritize and time handle various tasks- Results oriented- Demonstrate a positive demeanor and desire to succeed- Exhibits a high degree of flexibility in adapting to a constantly evolving business environment- English and German proficiency (minimum C1 level)Work Environment:At PPD clinical research services we hire the best, develop ourselves and each other, and recognize the power of being one team. We understand that you will want to grow both professionally and personally throughout your career, and therefore at PPD clinical research services you will benefit from an award-winning learning and development programme, ensuring you reach your potential.Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need. #StartYourStory with PPD, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.Severely disabled applicants with the same aptitude will be given preferential treatment. / Schwerbehinderte Bewerber werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt behandelt.

Become part of Tanso and decarbonize industries with us.What if the impact of your role extended beyond a job title?Not through marketing spin. Not through vague "purpose-driven" messaging. But through software that helps industrial companies understand, manage and actively reduce their environmental impact.That's what Tanso is building. And it's one of the reasons people join us.Why Tanso?• Take Action in a Fast-Moving, High-Impact Environment. We move fast on sustainability because the urgency is real. That means decisions that matter, transparent processes, and the agility to navigate change.• Challenge & Grow Through Ownership. Take ownership immediately, build expertise through hands-on experience, and leverage every available resource to achieve outsized impact.• Foster Trust with Mission-Driven Collaborators. You'll join a team that prioritizes impact and each other. We give honest feedback, share credit, support each other when it matters, and hold high standards together.• Embrace Responsibility & Drive Impact. Turn fragmented emissions data into actionable insights. Your work has immediate, visible impact - clearer decision-making and genuine momentum toward change.• AI First-Mindset. We embrace cutting-edge technology to solve sustainability challenges. Push the boundaries of innovation and stay ahead of what's possible.• Commitment to Performance & Excellence. We cultivate a high-performance culture where you thrive. Push yourself and others to excel, celebrate wins, learn from setbacks, and raise the bar.Your roleTo build the engine that lets Customer Success scale, we are looking for a Customer Strategy & Operations Manager (f/m/x) .As a Customer Strategy & Operations Manager, you will shape how Customer Success works at Tanso, from operating model and data to tooling, automation and scaled customer formats. Working closely with our Head of CS, you take ideas from concept to hands-on execution and make every CSM more impactful: more customers served, more value delivered, targets hit.Key responsibilities• Strategy & Operations: You shape how Customer Success operates. Together with the Head of CS, you continuously sharpen our operating model (segmentation, lifecycle, playbooks) and OKR/goal process – and bring it to life, from concept to rollout. As the central link to Sales, Marketing, Product, Engineering and Climate Intelligence, you make sure everything we build and do is aligned on customer value.• Tooling & Process Excellence: You keep the CS engine running and make it run smarter. You own and build our tech stack hands-on (HubSpot, Intercom, no-/low-code) and use automation and AI to free up CSMs to focus on what matters most: our customers.• Scaled Engagement & Enablement: You help CS scale. You build and run 1:n formats such as Tanso Academy, Tanso Update and our customer advisory board, and grow our customer community. With playbooks and templates, you enable CSMs to serve more customers without compromising on quality.• Projects & Strategic Initiatives: You turn ideas into impact. You lead cross-functional CS projects from concept to execution: pilot fast, measure impact, then scale or kill.Your profile• You have experience in Customer Success Operations, Revenue Operations, Strategy & Operations or consulting, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment.• You think in data: you build dashboards and analyses that answer real questions, and translate insights into clear priorities and actions.• You are hands-on with tools. You have worked with CRM and customer engagement platforms (ideally HubSpot and Intercom), enjoy building automations with no-/low-code tools, and are curious about using AI in daily work.• You have led cross-functional projects end to end and know how to align stakeholders across multiple departments.• You combine structured, strategic thinking with a pragmatic drive to get things done. You spot problems early, take ownership and see solutions through.• You communicate clearly and confidently, whether you’re writing a playbook or aligning with leadership.• You're business-fluent in English and German, both written and spoken.• You're based in Munich or willing to relocate.Nice to Have• Experience with scaled CS programs (webinars, academies, communities).• Interest in sustainability and carbon accounting.What we offer• A highly competitive compensation package with an attractive equity package to participate in Tanso's growth.• Hybrid working model that combines the benefits of onsite collaboration with the flexibility needed.• A company-contributed pension plan to support long-term financial security.• Yearly budget to support ongoing professional development.• Sponsored access to EGYM Wellpass to prioritize your wellbeing with thousands of options.• Exclusive discounts that help you save on a wide range of everyday brands, services, and experiences.Our teamWe're a diverse group of people, and that diversity is what makes us great. We bring unique perspectives to everything we do and are always eager to learn from each other. We work in cross-functional teams to tackle ambitious challenges, actively seek feedback and be the best versions of ourselves.About usTanso is an integrated sustainability software for carbon accounting and ESG data management. Our goal is to help manufacturing companies meet regulatory requirements and achieve their sustainability objectives.TansoWorking at Tanso

Your main focus will be to own the commercial relationship, drive adoption and retention, ensure successful renewals, and identify up- and cross-sell opportunities. You will work closely with Enablement, Data Hub, Sales, and Marketing to understand our product roadmap, share customer feedback, and ensure relevant updates reach customers in a clear and timely way.What to expectYour responsibilities will include:• Own and manage a scaled-touch account portfolio, ensuring consistent customer engagement, portfolio health, and commercial performance.• Manage the customer journey from onboarding and adoption to renewal and expansion, balancing scalable engagement with targeted high-impact touchpoints.• Develop and maintain strong relationships with decision-makers, practitioners, and key stakeholders across government accounts and related organizations.• Proactively identify customer risks by monitoring portfolio metrics, product usage, renewal signals, and customer feedback, and develop practical mitigation plans.• Identify growth opportunities within your portfolio to drive up- and cross-sell and strategically grow the account.• Create and execute lightweight account plans and success plans that support value realization, retention, and expansion across a larger account base.• Work closely with internal stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Success Services, Product, and Enablement to ensure customer satisfaction, timely issue resolution, and scalable customer success.Your profile in short• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience, ideally with a background or strong interest in OSINT, cybersecurity, law enforcement, public sector, or trust and safety.• 3+ years of experience in a B2B Account Management, Customer Success, or commercial customer-facing role, preferably in software, cybersecurity, OSINT, or investigations technology.• Proven experience working with government, public sector, law enforcement, intelligence, defense, or similarly regulated customers is required.• You understand the needs of scaled-touch customers and can prioritize effectively across a broad portfolio while still creating meaningful customer outcomes.• You bring strong communication skills, both in writing and in customer conversations, and can clearly articulate value to technical users, business stakeholders, and decision-makers.• You are familiar with cybersecurity, OSINT, investigations, or threat intelligence use cases and are motivated to support customers working in mission-critical environments.• You seek opportunities with a business and sales mind-set to find win/win solutions and grow the pie• You have an affinity for software tools and experience using Microsoft Office, CRM systems such as Salesforce, and Account Management or Customer Success tools.• Fluent in English and German (written and spoken), additional European languages are a plusWhy you will love MaltegoMaltego is a scale-up company. We provide you the benefits and security of larger corporations, coupled with the dynamic and fast-paced work environment and flat hierarchies of a start-up. We are proud to have a large global community that loves our product because it helps to solve the investigations that are most important. Here are some of the reasons why you will love Maltego:• Make an impact: Work in a scale-up environment with the opportunity to take ownership and make a direct, lasting contribution.• 30 days of paid vacation to relax, recharge, and enjoy life outside of work• Your wellbeing matters: Access mental health support and 1:1 sessions with certified psychologists through Nilo• Keep learning: Maltego supports your development, including subsidies for eligible language courses• Connect beyond the day-to-day: Join company events and celebrations that bring our international community together.• Collaborate with talented and mission-driven teams across the business.At Maltego, we are committed to supporting diversity and inclusion in our organization. We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all individuals regardless of race, religion, color, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.LocationBased in our Munich office, with a flexible hybrid working model requiring a minimum of 3 days per week in the officeRequired documents / informationReady to help drive the future of digital investigations? Apply now with your resume and a cover letter highlighting your experience!About usMaltego is the all-in-one investigation platform that accelerates complex cyber and OSINT investigations from hours to minutes. The Maltego platform powers preliminary quick OSINT investigations for digital profiling with Maltego Search as well as complex link analysis for large datasets with Maltego Graph. Through Maltego Evidence and Maltego Monitor, the platform enables investigators to collect, monitor, and preserve social media intelligence in real-time for prosecution and public safety. Whether cyber threat intelligence teams or law enforcement, Maltego equips your teams with the most essential and relevant data, with out-of-the-box access to common data sources and over 100 ready-made connectors to more. Mine, merge, and map all your essential intelligence in one place, and uncover hidden truths with Maltego!Learn more about how we can empower your investigations at www.maltego.com.
